description: This file is a C source file for a tracing or event logging system within a larger software project. It defines functions for generating JSON-formatted event logs, interacting with external components, and managing event-related configurations. The file specifically supports various event types such as start, exit, signal, error, command execution, data reporting, and timing metrics, and is part of the trace2 subsystem.
